not_amended: the task, its start pose, the acceptance criteria, the reward, the observation, the world, the network and the training budget are all untouched

evidence.advance_requires_collapse: 15 of 16 configurations gave the right hind leg a forward advance of 0.065 to 0.253, but every one of them did it with support 0.000, body height 0.662 and non-foot contact of 37 to 42 W, against a 4.889 W limit. preregistered_outcomes: if the leg both advances and keeps the body supported, the collapse was caused by the starting pose and the demonstration can be fixed
if the body still collapses, the mutual exclusion is a property of the body under this actuator and the leg is recorded as a body level limit, closing the single leg effort
